title: Case 021: Missed Scheduled Instalment
initial_request: I’m Ella Hughes at 121 Birch Walk, Brackenford, ZZ3 3ZZ. Please tell me how to resolve the missed scheduled instalment safely and let me know once the insurer confirms its status.
overview: Northmere Mutual's Payment Team told Rob at Elmstead Cover that an instalment for Ella Hughes's property policy had not gone through and provided a secure repayment route. Rob notified Ella without asking her to send payment details by email. Ella said she had used the secure channel, and the Payment Team later confirmed that the instalment was settled and stated the current payment status. Rob passed that confirmation on; no statement was made about cover being restored or changed.

next_action.summary: At the escalation point, Rob should pass the missed-instalment notice and Northmere Mutual's secure repayment instructions to Ella without requesting payment credentials by email.

outcome: Northmere Mutual's Payment Team confirmed that the instalment was settled and confirmed the current payment status.

events.body: Our records show that the scheduled instalment for Ella Hughes's property policy at 121 Birch Walk, Brackenford, ZZ3 3ZZ did not go through. Please direct her to the secure payment area in her Northmere Mutual account to make the payment; she should not send card or bank details by email.

Northmere Mutual has advised that your scheduled instalment did not go through. Please use the secure payment area in your Northmere Mutual account to address it, and do not reply with payment details; let me know once you have used that channel so I can ask the Payment Team to confirm the status.
I have used the secure payment channel in my Northmere Mutual account for the missed instalment. Please check with the Payment Team that it has been recorded.

Ella Hughes advises that she has used the secure payment channel for the missed instalment on her policy for 121 Birch Walk, Brackenford, ZZ3 3ZZ. Could you confirm whether the payment has been settled and advise the current payment status?
We confirm that Ella Hughes's missed instalment has been settled and the payment status is current. This confirms the payment status only.

Northmere Mutual's Payment Team has confirmed that the missed instalment has been settled and that your payment status is current. This is confirmation of the payment status; I have no separate confirmation here of any change to cover.
